card.name: Dose adjusted to maintain a target
card.fires_on: Words about adjusting a dose, rate or frequency (adjusted, dose, frequency, flow) right before a purpose phrase such as "to maintain" or "to achieve" a target level or pH.

modes.label: Adjust verb
modes.description: The word adjusted comes right before a goal phrase for a lab or pH target.
modes.example: The bicarbonate dose should be<< adjusted>> to maintain the urine pH at 7

modes.label: Dose noun
modes.description: The noun dose, frequency or flow comes right before a phrase that sets a target.
